newsitem.title: FINLAND: FINNISH BONDS END FIRMER AHEAD OF GREENSPAN.
newsitem.headline: FINNISH BONDS END FIRMER AHEAD OF GREENSPAN.

text.p: 1645/1345 GMT -- Bonds track Bunds quietly to close up as
players hope for encouraging comments from Fed chief Greenspan
at 2100/1800 GMT, dealers say. Markka up a shade, activity
subdued by holidays, dealers said. Lower budget deficit seen
good for bonds but had little impact, pay talks matter more.
*FIM-06 yld pct 5.82 vs 5.87 *06 gap over Bund bps 28 vs 29
*FIM-04 yld pct 5.43 vs 5.46 *FIM-99 yld pct 3.78 vs 3.78
*Sept FRAs 3.28 pct vs 3.31 *June FRAs 4.11 pct vs 4.14
